response.justification: Bogdan brings 15+ years of broad engineering experience, current AI-native tooling work (MCP code generators, agentic workflows), and genuine high-throughput systems exposure at Dunnhumby/Sociomantic. However, the role requires strong Python, which is entirely absent from his resume (his systems work is in DLang and Node/TypeScript), and evidence of Staff-level technical strategy, cross-functional stakeholder leadership, and operational/on-call ownership is thin. Worth a conversation to probe distributed-systems depth and Python transferability, but not a clear fit on paper.
strengths: Current hands-on experience with AI-agent infrastructure and MCP tooling in an AI-native environment
Real high-throughput, low-latency systems experience (millions of HTTP requests/sec at Sociomantic)
Strong engineering craftsmanship: TDD, CI/CD, open-source authorship, teaching and community workshops
concerns: No Python experience listed — a must-have for this role
Limited evidence of Staff-level technical strategy, stakeholder management, or driving decisions at scale
No explicit mention of operational ownership, on-call/incident response, or formal agile/scrum experience
